item.title: Watch: Deli Manager Encourages Students to Succeed in School
item.description: ABC News' Danny New speaks with New York City bodega owner Wail Alselwi, who has been giving students cash rewards and free items for good grades...

item.title: U.S. and Iran exchange strikes for first time in a month
item.description: Iran claims it attacked U.S. bases in Jordan after CENTCOM reported strikes on rocket launchers on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran live updates: U.S. launches first strikes since July, Tehran retaliates
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains the main flashpoint in the conflict.

item.title: House reconvenes with vote expected on Senate bill to avert shutdown
item.description: Lawmakers may also vote on condemning socialism and censuring GOP Rep. Chuck Edwards.
